verdict.rationale: There is a help article titled "Sync and manage websites" and an API for creating content import sources from a URL. Intercom also says it brings content from Zendesk, Confluence, Notion and the help center together so Fin "always" works from the same source of truth. Together these suggest connected, synced knowledge sources rather than manual uploads, but the pack only shows titles and marketing lines, with no detail on how syncing actually happens. Missing for 10: documented scheduled re-sync cadence, change-triggered (webhook or event-driven) re-sync of knowledge sources, sync freshness or status visibility, and independent or hands-on confirmation that content stays current without manual re-imports.
